purpose: R1 byte-frozen custom/synthetic probe corpus for engine/runtime semantics validation
authority: Probe results validate engine semantics only. They are not alpha evidence and never create promotion assessments.

canonical_dataset.hash_rule: SHA-256 of exact original input bytes before provider upload

execution_conventions.market_buy_on_close_true: fill on the decision bar close
execution_conventions.market_buy_on_close_false: fill on the next bar open
execution_conventions.commission: quote-currency fee charged on executed notional per side
execution_conventions.slippage: disabled unless a probe explicitly enables it; when enabled it is applied to the execution price, never ambiguously to an unrelated bar close
execution_conventions.limit_orders: probe-specific; ambiguous OHLC-only intrabar sequencing must be classified rather than silently assumed

probes.goal: Detect integer/fractional position-sizing failures like the historical BTC benchmark defect.
Determine buy_on_close versus next-bar-open execution semantics with hand-computable bars.
Verify commission application and fee rounding.
Verify indicators do not trade on NaN or insufficient warmup windows.
Verify sell-then-buy state transitions and no accidental simultaneous gross exposure.
Verify minimum holding period and entry/exit threshold hysteresis.
Document OHLC-only limit-order fill assumptions and detect ambiguous intrabar sequencing.
Verify UTC normalization and day/4h boundary conventions from 1-minute source bars.
Verify duplicate, missing-policy, unsorted, malformed, and non-finite bars fail closed before research.
Verify open positions, unrealized P&L, and final valuation treatment.
Expose whether future-bar access is blocked, permitted, or silently contaminates a result.
Verify declared strategy behavior independently of performance summaries.
Prove family/candidate/split/result identities cannot be mixed to fabricate validation or promotion lineage.
Prove an unrelated or post-result audit event cannot satisfy confirmatory pre-registration.
